metadata.goal: Analyze how taxi activity differs around holidays and special days.
metadata.header: Porto Taxi Activity before Holidays and Special Days
metadata.dataset_description: A constructed comparison of 320 road-aligned Porto taxi trips across four pre-holiday or special days and four seasonally matched ordinary weekdays in 2014. Trip time, distance class, request type, and GPS traces support all four comparisons.

insights: Days immediately preceding holidays or special days show a stronger concentration of taxi trips in the late evening than ordinary days.
The trips on pre-holiday day evenings are usually towards north of the city, while trips on ordinary evenings are more evenly distributed.
Pre-holiday trips contain a higher proportion of medium- and long-distance journeys than trips during comparable ordinary evenings.
Street-hail trips take a larger share in the morning of both pre-holiday and ordinary days, but the proportion decreases after mid-day, especially in pre-holiday periods.
summary: Pre-holiday and special-day activity is disproportionately concentrated late in the evening, and those evening trips are usually directed north while ordinary-evening destinations are more evenly distributed across north, east, central, west, and south sectors. Pre-holiday evenings also contain a much larger medium/long-distance share. Street hails lead in the morning for both day classes, then decline after midday, especially on pre-holiday days.
